text: Cancel or stop an order before shipment when a customer changes their mind or no longer needs an item. A support employee must approve cancellation. Paid orders may receive a simulated refund; shipped orders cannot be cancelled.
Refunds and money-back requests require verified payment and human review. The prototype does not send money or write to a payment gateway.
Order tracking and shipment status are read-only. Verify customer ownership before returning order status. Do not invent delivery dates.
Stock availability and inventory quantities must come from the warehouse database. Do not promise an unreserved item.
Verify payment status from business records. Failed, unpaid or unverified payments block shipment.
Shipping address updates and other order modifications require human review. Never directly change an address from model output.
Conditional, conflicting or unclear requests require human review. No order changes may occur until the employee authorizes a supported action.
Fulfillment requires a paid processing order with no unresolved support ticket. Block unpaid or cancelled orders and log the decision.
